answer: I stake the epoch on Stitcher vellum leaf mark stitched into the bindery register. The stake is real because each vellum leaf is a gilt edge pressed beside the binders mark, so a farm must takes years, not minutes. No bulk discount exists: 654 aliases need 654 proofs, and each proof is 104 POA the farm cannot reuse. The echo names the issuer, the tide names the price, and the jetty names the date: a forger must forge all three. The panel needs no trust, only the record — and the record is public.
